profile.visual_direction: expressive, colorful, approachable merchandising with a clear focal point, energetic accents, and a theme derived from the source
profile.typography_direction: bold rounded display type paired with a clean readable sans; use color blocks and badges for scanning, never clutter or unreadable microcopy
profile.mockup_direction: bright lifestyle, device, or flat-lay scenes with playful but believable props selected from the product category

generation_provenance.art_direction_summary: A source-led Etsy listing gallery for Daisy Flow Digital: exact planner pages dominate bright, colorful information graphics, with a generated lavender color-block background and no lifestyle props.

concept_board.hero: One large exact January 2027 monthly page is the thumbnail subject, with high-contrast digital-download disclosure.
concept_board.palette: Lavender, saturated amethyst, teal, coral, butter yellow, deep plum, and clean white page cards.
concept_board.mockup: No photographic device mockups in the listing graphics; the PDF pages are shown as clean framed source-page previews.
concept_board.gallery_rhythm: Hero, overview, section map, monthly, daily, wellness, weekly, navigation, extras, and thank-you; colorful labels create scanning hierarchy without hiding source evidence.
concept_board.iconography: Small rounded color labels and page-count markers only; no invented app icons or compatibility symbols.
